hypotheses.statement: LB has a higher growth rate than M9 glucose.
hypotheses.rationale: Rich medium (LB) supports faster growth than minimal medium.
hypotheses.falsified_if: r(LB) is not greater than r(M9_glucose) at Holm-adjusted p < 0.05
objections: Only 4 and 4 replicates; the t-test has little power to detect small effects.
Data are synthetic; this verdict says nothing about real cultures.

objections: 4 of 8 curve fits have R2 below 0.98.

hypotheses.statement: Acetate has a longer lag than M9 glucose.
hypotheses.rationale: Poor carbon sources such as acetate lengthen the lag phase.
hypotheses.falsified_if: t0(M9_acetate) is not greater than t0(M9_glucose) at Holm-adjusted p < 0.05
objections: 4 of 8 curve fits have R2 below 0.98.
Curves for M9_acetate did not reach plateau within the run, so K is not identifiable and r and lag are biased. Extend the run before testing this.
Only 4 and 4 replicates; the t-test has little power to detect small effects.
Data are synthetic; this verdict says nothing about real cultures.
Lag is defined relative to a fixed inoculum OD; an error in that value shifts every lag.
